items.followUp: Write the SI unit of energy and define it.

rubric.why: Identifies the SI unit of power.
rubric.how: Award for stating that the SI unit of power is the watt (W).

rubric.why: States that power measures how quickly work is done.
rubric.how: Award for defining power as the rate of doing work, or work done per unit time.

modelAnswer: The SI unit of power is the watt (W).
Power is the rate of doing work: 1 W = 1 J s⁻¹.

items.followUp: Define mechanical advantage and write its formula.

rubric.why: Identifies efficiency as comparing useful output with input.
rubric.how: Award for stating that efficiency compares useful output with the input.
Award for the correct useful output to input ratio, expressed as a percentage.

modelAnswer: Efficiency is the ratio of useful work output to work input.

items.followUp: A substance has mass 6 kg and volume 2 m³. Find its density.

rubric.why: States the defining relationship for density.
rubric.how: Award for defining density as mass per unit volume.

rubric.why: Gives the density formula and SI unit.
rubric.how: Award for the formula ρ = m/V and the SI unit kg m⁻³.

modelAnswer: Density is the mass per unit volume of a substance.
The SI unit of density is kg/m³.

items.followUp: Why does an iron nail sink in water?

rubric.why: Identifies the density comparison that explains flotation.
rubric.how: Award for stating that the density of wood is less than the density of water.

rubric.why: Connects flotation to the upward force exerted by water.
rubric.how: Award for explaining that water's upthrust supports the block so it floats.

modelAnswer: A wooden block floats on water because its density is less than the density of water.
The upthrust exerted by water can support the block, so it floats.

items.followUp: A force makes an angle of 60° with the horizontal. Its horizontal component is 15 N. Find the force.

rubric.why: Identifies the given horizontal component and angle.
rubric.how: Award for recording the horizontal component as 20 N and the angle as 30°.

rubric.why: Uses and rearranges the relationship between the force and its horizontal component.
rubric.how: Award for stating Fₓ = F cos θ and rearranging it to F = Fₓ/cos θ.

rubric.why: Substitutes the given values and obtains the force with a unit.
rubric.how: Award for substituting 20 N and 30° and giving approximately 23.1 N, or 23 N to suitable rounding.

modelAnswer: Given: Horizontal component, Fₓ = 20 N; angle, θ = 30°.
Formula: Fₓ = F cos θ, so F = Fₓ/cos θ.
